items.label: la nausée
items.scene: A seasick sailor, cheeks slightly green, holds his NOSE ("noh-ZAY") as NAUSEA rolls over him in the patient's chair.

items.label: l'irruption
items.scene: A sudden OUTBREAK ("ee-rewp-SYOHN"): a basket of kittens on a stool ERUPTS in sneezes, ribbons flying.

items.label: la consultation
items.scene: A giraffe pokes her long neck in at the window for a CONSULTATION ("kohn-sewl-tah-SYOHN"), sticking out a sore tongue.

items.label: le symptôme
items.scene: A little doctor mouse turns the pages of a TOME ("sanp-TOHM") as big as a door, looking up a SYMPTOM.

items.label: le rhume
items.scene: A boy with a COLD and a red nose sits wrapped in a blanket, his used tissues piled so high they fill the ROOM ("REWM").

items.label: le vaccin
items.scene: A brave teddy bear holds out his paw for a VACCINE ("vahk-SAN") and gets a gold star sticker; the capped syringe is a harmless prop.
